# Megga Coffee

> Megga Coffee is a café and brunch spot at 1696 Danforth Ave in Toronto's Danforth East, near Coxwell Station. The menu includes espresso, Habesha dishes such as ful and fata, eggs Benedict and pancakes.

## Visit

- Address: 1696 Danforth Ave, Toronto, ON M4C 1H8, Canada
- Neighbourhood: Danforth East, Toronto, a short walk from Coxwell subway station (Line 2)
- Phone: (647) 575-9431
- Payment: Credit cards, Debit cards
- Amenities: Free Wi-Fi, Laptop friendly, Power outlets, Restroom, Outdoor seating, Parking nearby
- Work and study: free Wi-Fi and power outlets. Guests are welcome to stay with a laptop to work or study any time the café is open.
- Google rating: 5.0 stars from 27 reviews
- Order delivery or pickup: https://www.ubereats.com/ca/store/megga-morning-grace-coffee/lcxvV_vkUyulXjWnfndXcA
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Megga+coffee+1696+Danforth+Ave+Toronto

## Hours (Toronto time)

- Every day: 8 a.m. to 9 p.m.

- [Menu](https://meggacoffee.com/menu): full menu with prices and photos
